selected_records.title: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $\Phi$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration

article.body:
# arXiv paper focuses on marine anomaly detection aboard Φsat-2

A paper listed in arXiv’s cs.CV category on Oct. 8, 2026, is titled “Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on Φsat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration.”

The title identifies the work as addressing marine anomaly detection onboard Φsat-2 and a development path from simulation to an in-orbit demonstration. The available record does not provide the authors, the anomaly-detection method, details of the demonstration or any results.

The paper is listed at arXiv under identifier 2610.11735.
